TST-0288.retry_policy: Two strikes then pivot (AGENTS.md 4b): after a second failure on the same hypothesis, enumerate at least two alternative approaches before a third attempt.
TST-0288.reviewer_requirement: One reviewer with a statistics mandate who must re-run the comparison from the raw per-case results and independently reproduce the reported effect size and interval.

TST-0297.evidence_requirement: Report the null-delta distribution over at least 10 repeated identical runs, with its standard deviation. Every later improvement claim in this program must cite this floor.
inputs: tools/bench/ (the benchmark and regression platform built by this lane)
environment capture from lane C unit for admissibility
_USER-PROMPTS.md:10577 (stagger arrivals; arrival rate is a scheduler input)
TST-0297.question_or_target: Question: how much of a measured delta is the change, and how much is the harness moving under it? Capture and freeze everything that can vary (seed, model id and snapshot, temperature, tool versions, OS, locale, concurrency), then measure the null delta - the same configuration run twice - and publish it as the variance floor. Any improvement smaller than the variance floor is not a result, and the platform must refuse to report it as one.
TST-0297.retry_policy: Re-run is permitted only with a NEW recorded seed; re-running the same seed to get a different answer is a detector failure and must be reported as one.
TST-0297.reviewer_requirement: One reviewer with a statistics mandate who must re-run the comparison from the raw per-case results and independently reproduce the reported effect size and interval.
tests_required: Null-delta measurement: identical config run 10+ times, distribution published.
Seed wiring proof: changing only the seed must change the result set, or the seed is inert.
Environment drift alarm: a run whose captured environment differs from the baseline must be flagged, not silently compared.
TST-0297.title: Pin determinism: seeds, model versions, environment capture and a run-to-run variance budget

TST-0303.evidence_requirement: Publish the per-class TTL table and the count of currently expired results. A dashboard showing green must show the age of each green.
inputs: tools/bench/ (the benchmark and regression platform built by this lane)
the dependency classification from B01 provenance fields
TST-0303.question_or_target: Question: a stored green from last week is not a control for today when the check queries a live advisory database, a marketplace index or a model endpoint that ships new snapshots. Classify every benchmark case by whether its oracle depends on an external live source, assign a staleness TTL per class, and make the platform refuse to cite an expired result as current evidence. The failure is subtle because the expired result is not wrong, it is merely no longer a measurement of today.
TST-0303.retry_policy: No automatic retry: a failure here is a finding, not a transient. Re-run only after a named change to the harness or the fixture.
TST-0303.reviewer_requirement: One independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context who did not author the harness under test and who must reproduce the both-states control before signing off.
tests_required: Expired result cannot satisfy a gate: prove by back-dating a result past its TTL.
Live-dependency classification checked against the actual network calls each oracle makes, not against its declared class.
Both-states: a hermetic case must NOT expire, so the TTL does not force pointless re-runs.
TST-0303.title: Expire benchmark results that depend on a live external source

TST-0309.evidence_requirement: Report kappa with n, and the DIRECTION of judge errors (which way it is biased), because direction matters more than accuracy when the downstream action is a release decision.
TST-0309.question_or_target: Implementation target: where a benchmark case can be scored by an exact algorithm, the platform must use the algorithm; where only a model judgement is available, the platform must report the judge agreement rate that licenses trusting it. Measure Cohen kappa between the judge and the deterministic oracle on the subset where both exist, then extrapolate the error bar onto the judged-only subset. On this estate an LLM classification of a mechanical comparison measured 86 percent accurate with 100 percent of errors pointing one way, which is why oracle-first is a rule and not a preference.
TST-0309.retry_policy: Two strikes then pivot (AGENTS.md 4b): after a second failure on the same hypothesis, enumerate at least two alternative approaches before a third attempt.
TST-0309.reviewer_requirement: One reviewer with a statistics mandate who must re-run the comparison from the raw per-case results and independently reproduce the reported effect size and interval.
tests_required: Kappa on the overlap subset with per-class error direction.
Oracle-first enforcement: a case with an available deterministic oracle that is scored by the judge must fail a lint check.
Judge-swap: a second judge model on the same cases; disagreement between judges bounds how much either can be trusted.
TST-0309.title: Measure judge-model agreement against deterministic oracles and mandate the oracle where one exists

Both-states enforced automatically by the closure tool, not by reviewer discipline.
Backfill census: report how many already-closed defects lack a pre-fix failing run and treat that number as debt, not as pass.
TST-0313.title: Every closed defect must leave behind a regression case that would catch its return

TST-0322.evidence_requirement: Show the verifier detecting all three tamper classes on a copy of the real ledger. Report the ledger row count and the verification wall-clock so the check is known to be practical.

tools/bench/ (the benchmark and regression platform built by this lane)
TST-0322.question_or_target: Implementation target: every number this program cites eventually traces to the results ledger, so a silently mutated past result poisons every downstream claim. Make the ledger append-only with a per-row content hash chained to the previous row, and ship the verifier that detects insertion, deletion and in-place edit. This is the integrity substrate under B16 (generated tables) and B12 (overfitting series), both of which are worthless if history can move.
TST-0322.retry_policy: No automatic retry: a failure here is a finding, not a transient. Re-run only after a named change to the harness or the fixture.
TST-0322.reviewer_requirement: One independent reviewer who re-runs the probe under a SECOND Windows shell (pwsh7 and Git Bash) and reports any divergence as a finding rather than a retry.
tests_required: Tamper controls: in-place edit, deleted row and inserted row each DETECTED.
Clean ledger verifies silently (no false positive).
Concurrent-writer safety on Windows: two writers appending simultaneously must not interleave a torn row, tested with real concurrent processes.
TST-0322.title: Make the results ledger append-only and prove a retroactive edit is detectable

TST-0328.evidence_requirement: The fixture itself must be exercised by a self-test that includes a deliberately silent detector and confirms the fixture REJECTS it. A fixture that cannot fail is the same bug one level up.

TST-0328.question_or_target: Implementation target: spec :10658 requires verifying detectors against known-broken and known-good controls. A probe that is silent in both states measures nothing, and on this estate that exact failure reached the point of being reported as verification, so the discipline needs to be a callable, not a reminder.

Adoption census: report how many registered detectors currently use the fixture versus a hand-rolled control.
TST-0328.title: Ship a reusable both-states fixture so a detector must fire on the broken state before it is trusted
